entries.alt: A dark-bearded guest in blue rests his hand on a prominent patterned cushion while a younger guest in brown attends to a lower place beside the table and an older host stands behind.
entries.caption: Jesus notices how guests choose places of honor and teaches them about humility. This imagined wedding gathering introduces the contrast between seeking prominence and taking a lower place.
entries.findings: Luke14:7 supplies the observed choice of honored places; verse8 introduces the wedding example explicitly pictured in the unchanged caption. This addendum corrects source specificity only and does not replace review52 or imply owner approval.
